Generics frmtmb re-exports from the package that owns them.

Source: R/generic-owners.R
frmtmb-shared-generics.Rd

nlme is Recommended and ships with R; generics declares only base packages, library(generics) costing 0.000 s at the minimum of 12 replicates against 0.860 s for lme4 (dev/generics-loadcost.R). So these four are free. Three of them need nothing further; refit also joins the run-time table, because lme4 defines a rival refit that this import cannot reach.
